test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

If you could wait for just half an hour you will certain be able to meet her.
solution:
The correct answer is **'you will certain'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement has **'certain'** which is an **adverb** since it gives an affirmative tone to the sentence. it is also known **adverb of affirmation**.
 
• Adverbs usually end with the suffix -ly.

**Thus, the correct sentence is**__: *If you could wait for just half an hour you will **certainly** be able to meet her*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Adverbs usually end with the suffix -ly. But there are exceptions to this rule depending on whether the word is a flat adverb.
 
• Flat adverbs: similar in form to that of an adjective and may not necessarily have a suffix -ly in the end. Example: fast, often, hard, very.
 
• Example in a sentence:
 
 
• Raju worked** hard** for the upcoming Maths exam. 
 
• Raju worked** hardly** for the upcoming Maths exam. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 
 
 

​In the given sentence - ​If you could wait for just half an hour, you will certainly be able to meet her," is a hypothetical condition that is typically part of the second conditional ("If you could wait for just half an hour") it shows a real future possibility ("you will certainly be able to meet her")

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Point__**

__
 
• Adjectives also end with the suffix -ly. Example: friendly, lonely, elderly, chilly.
 
• Example in a sentence:
 
 
• Kriti felt her office colleagues were **friendly** and welcoming.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **Hint__**

 
• Noticing whether the word in question is an **adverb** or **adjective**. if it is an adverb is it a **flat adverb** that might help answer the question
